items.title: Costco (COST) Stock May Be Priced For Perfection On Cash Flow
items.summary: Costco Wholesale has delivered a powerful long term share price run, yet the recent pullback and fresh headlines on margins and special dividends put a sharper question on the table for you as an investor. Is the current US$893.93 stock price fully explained by the cash Costco can generate over time, once you strip away short term swings in sentiment and sector calls? Over the past 5 years the stock has gained about 108.3%, which puts real weight on whether that climb is in line with what...

items.title: Should You Buy Home Depot Stock Near Its Lowest Price-To-Sales In Ten Years?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) shares trade near $300, down about 26% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned about 17%. Housing turnover has sat at historic lows for four years, and investors doubt the quality of Home Depot's reported profit. One number argues the other way. The stock trades at 1.8 times trailing sales, against a ten-year range of 1.7 to 2.9.
